title: Qwen3.8 27B overthinking for you? I have a question
body:
What is your model/kv cache quant and your tg/s

My theory on why some people don’t experience overthinking:

over 30 tg/s its fast enough that the extended thinking doesn’t matter. Also staying at least q4 quant and unquant kv cache solves two issues: 1. Lower chance of going into endless loop, 2. Keeps output quality high so the extended thinking seems pullings it’s weight

submitted by /u/Pyrolistical
summaryZh: 用户讨论了Qwen模型推理速度与“过度思考”现象之间的关系，主要基于个人使用体验。
